S2.veh.boat_mat_shelter_20805: a low boat moored close in to the north bank (types #15's west part; the catalogue's small_awning): kind small; painted 3.3 m at about half of life, built lw 4.8 (0.6 of the type) and beam 1.8 (a real proportion for 4.8 m); free 0.6 (no crew support; the small type's low hull). Its woven mat roof over the west half is the kit's arched awning, a jar under its east roof. No crew, mast or sweep (painted none). Waits on the boat factory: the flat roof with a slatted eave and the higher mat roof east of the awning (B1), the big coil lying on its roof (the kit puts roof cargo only on a passenger cabin).
S2.veh.boat_big_cabin_21120: a big river boat moored along the north bank before the shops (types #15's east part; catalogue: passenger): lw 11.4 (0.6 of the type; painted 6.8 m at about half of life), beam 3.0 (Song inland proportion for that length); free 0.8: its cabin floor is painted 0.58 m over the water at the far-row scale (S4b's long cabin took 0.8 for 0.58), and the bank top then stands 0.1 m over its deck for boarding. Its low windowed cabin and the deckhouse with a sloping mat roof are one house cabin with a mat roof from 0.24 to 0.62 of the hull; the flat mat awning on posts over the coils at the bow is the kit's bow canopy, three of the six coils along the far (starboard) gunwale under it; the high stern's gabled rudder house is the kit's stern house (its steersman stands on the gallery beside it). No mast or sail. Waits on the boat factory: the round windlass hub at the stem head (B3), the flat awning as painted (B1); the long pole slanting from the bow into the water is not in the kit.
S2.veh.boat_mat_cargo_21055: a long low cargo boat moored outside the bank row (types #14; catalogue: grain_awning_sweep without its sweep): kind grain, riding high under mat (hold awning, laden false); lw 12 (0.6 of the type; painted 7.75 m with its west end hidden), beam 3.1; free 0.8: its deck is painted 0.68 m over the water at the far-row scale. Bow east (the map's reading), so its small cabin with the planked doorway and sloping mat roof at the east end is the kit's house at 0.80-0.94 of the hull (from the stern); a coil on its after deck and the big lidded water jar on its foredeck. No mast, sweep or oars (painted none). Its mooring rope to the foot of S2.tree.willow_top_20668 is not built: rafted outside the big cabin boat at real size, the rope would run across that boat. Waits on the boat factory: the long dark arched mat roof over its west (after) part and the low mat cover over the cargo amidships as painted (B1; the kit's hold awnings stand amidships), the lattice rail amidships.
S2.veh.boat_skiff_21080: an empty open skiff under the south willow's whips (catalogue: small_open): kind small, open (awning false), lw 4.8 (0.6 of the type; painted 4.5 m with its east end hidden), beam 1.5 (a skiff's narrow hull), free 0.45 (the lowest that keeps the kit's floor boards above the water); no cargo, nobody aboard (painted none). Waits on the boat factory: the pointed west end (B2).
S2.veh.boat_covered_21205: a small covered boat off the south bank (catalogue: small_awning): kind small, lw 4.8 (painted 4.0 m), beam 1.7, free 0.6 (its deck painted 0.56 m over the water); the mat canopy over most of its length is the kit's arched awning; a round basket on its after (west) deck; no laundry. Its two passengers sit under the canopy. Waits on the boat factory: the canopy on four thin posts, gabled at the east end, so the passengers show (B1), and the squared, raised bow board.
S2.veh.boat_open_21968: a small open boat at the foot of the south bank's mound (types #17; catalogue: small_open): kind small, open, lw 4.8 (painted 4.4 m), beam 1.6; free 0.45: its gunwale is painted only 0.27 m over the water, which would put the kit's floor boards under it, so 0.45, the least that keeps them dry; its squared west end tied by its rope to the mound's face at (176.4, 1.76), as painted. Two crew (a seated man, a crouching shape). The knobs on its far gunwale are not in the kit.
S2.veh.boat_sweep_22000: the boat under way west in midstream worked by six men at a great stern sweep (types #16; catalogue: grain_awning_sweep, working): kind grain, hold awning (its hull is lost under the willow's whips; the catalogue's preset), laden false; lw 12 (0.6 of the type; the painted after part is 2.9 m, its bow not painted) with its painted stern kept (moves); beam 3.4; free 1.4: its raised after deck is painted 1.43 m over the water. sweep 'port': its blade trails east-south-east, on the south side of a boat heading west, and lies on the water as painted (u 22780-22945). No crew house aft (cabin false): the six men crowd the after deck at the loom, and the kit stands the sweep's crew aft of any house. Pose rowed (the map's): the page rows it west 4 m and back (boats_people.json). Not in the kit: the decorated oval panel with eye-like marks on its stern side.
S2.veh.boat_mat_roof_22290: a long boat moored along the low south spit (types #18; the lead's note and the catalogue: small_awning): kind small (the scan, gen/sections/canal/boats/crops/mat_roof_22290.jpg: a small hull 8-9 m against its bucket man, an arched mat roof with cloths hung under its west end, an open after deck, a lashed stern frame and rudder); lw 8.0 (the type; painted 8.8 m), beam 2.3; free 0.8: its stern quarter is painted 1.23 m over the water and amidships about 0.9, and the kit's sheer rises 0.45 m aft. Its arched mat roof with cloths hung along it (cloths), a basket and tub on deck under it, a rope from its bow down to the spit at (184.5, -1.6). Waits on the boat factory: the overhanging lashed stern frame and the rudder (B6); the raked pole with a cloth leaning west from the roof's west post is not in the kit.
S2.veh.boat_passenger_22545: 豪华客船 (types #19, pin 17; catalogue: passenger, the factory's model): kind passenger, lw 13 (0.68 of the type; painted 16.2 m, shortened so the north-bank row of four boats fits between the big cabin boat and the bank's turn at the great willow), beam 3.8; free 0.95: its side walkway is painted 0.91 m over the water. Bow west: the open fore canopy on four posts is the kit's bow canopy; the mat-curtained cabin and the long lattice-windowed cabin are one passenger cabin from 0.30 to 0.84 of the hull in three roof segments, its ladder from the walkway to the roof at 4.5 m from the stern on the near (port) side, as painted (u 23240-23310); the open bay with its two passengers is open deck aft of the cabin; the after cabin with mat blinds and a roof deck is the kit's stern house (its windlass man stands on its roof). Roof cargo as painted: a coil, two round baskets and a rolled mat. Moored to S2.prop.mooring_post_23126, the post standing in the water off the terrace (moved with the shore). No mast (painted none); its stern is painted hidden. Waits on the boat factory: the windlass and the small arched mat shelter on the after roof (B3, B1), the open bay as an open cabin (B4), the curved stem post with its netted knob.
S2.veh.boat_towed_mast_23632: 逆水行舟 (types #20-21, pin 15; catalogue: grain_mast_towed with a passenger cabin): kind grain, hold hatch (hatch boards under the cabin; no awnings), laden false; lw 19 (0.95 of the type; painted 19.8 m), beam 4.3 (mapped 4.0); free 0.91: its wale is painted 0.91 m over the water. Its long plank-walled cabin with lattice windows the whole length under a low mat roof is a passenger-pattern cabin with a mat roof, 1.6 m walls (painted about 1.5), from 0.10 to 0.84 of the hull in three segments: its five roof crew stand on its roof. Its mast up at 0.6 of the hull (painted at u 24190), 10 m (its painted top 10.35 m over the ground at the painted place), the tow line from the masthead to the lead tracker S2.fig.tracker_lead_21867 (tow_to; the page re-aims it at his shoulder as the trackers walk). A coil of bamboo rope on the after deck. Pose towed (the map's): the page hauls it west 4 m and back (boats_people.json). Waits on the boat factory: the single pole mast stepped in a braced tabernacle on the cabin roof with its fan of stays (B7: the kit's A-frame stands in tabernacles on the deck, its legs through the cabin roof), the dark arched mat hood over the bow (B1), the sweep shipped aft (B5), the two boat-hooks crossed over the stem.
S2.veh.boat_cargo_hooded_bow_23715: a very long high-sided cargo boat lying along the north bank (types #20 north hull and #23-27; catalogue: grain_awning_sweep without its sweep): kind grain, riding high (laden false); hold hatch: its deck is painted open and busy (a board platform, coils, an open-sided deckhouse, windlasses, nine crew), which the kit's arched hold awnings would roof over (all nine crew stood under them in the crew check); the kit's mat-roofed crew house aft (0.07-0.27) stands for the huge rounded mat cover over its after cargo; coils and baskets on its foredeck (the kit's default). lw 13 (0.65 of the type; painted 18.7 m, shortened so the north-bank row fits), beam 3.8; free 2.0: its deck is painted 2.47 m over the water (an unladen hull); 2.0 keeps its deck within the page's boarding reach of the bank (1.2 m above the bank top at most) and its strakes high. No mast; no rope (painted none). Waits on the boat factory: the dark mat hood over the bow and the deckhouse's hood (B1), the open-sided deckhouse with pin 16's two men (B4), the spoked windlasses at the bow and aft (B3), its short ladder up to the bank (B8), the coil and rope-wrapped fenders on its south side (B11).
S2.veh.boat_moored_mat_canopy_25145: a big plank-built boat moored before 沿河雅座 (types #23-27; catalogue: grain_awning_sweep without its sweep): kind grain, riding high, hold awning (the kit's arched mat awnings amidships stand for its foredeck canopy and long rounded mat cabin roof, painted from 0.17 to 0.71 of the hull), laden false; lw 12 (0.6 of the type; painted 13.2 m), beam 3.4; free 2.0 (its deck is painted 2.7 m over the water; 2.0 for boarding from the bank, as the hooded-bow boat); its mooring rope from the bow's bitts up the bank to S2.prop.mooring_post_25207 (moved with the bank), coils at the bow's bitt beams. Its three crew stand on the open deck at the awnings' ends (moves: the kit's awnings are closed). Waits on the boat factory: the broad canopy on posts over the foredeck and the long rounded mat cabin roof as painted (B1), the raised hatch board and the casks on its roof.
S2.veh.boat_mat_cabin_25980: a big timber boat moored west of the great willow (types #23-27; the lead's note and the catalogue: passenger with board walls): the scan (gen/sections/canal/boats/crops/mat_cabin_25980.jpg) shows a deep planked hull riding high with a long plank-walled cabin with doors, a gable-roofed fore cabin, mat hoods aft and a raised stern gallery: kind passenger, cabin pattern 'boards' from 0.38 to 0.92 of the hull (the gable fore cabin and the long cabin, two roof segments) with its ladder from the deck to the roof at 8.1 m on the near side (painted u 26200-26255); three coiled bundles on its roof. lw 11.4 (0.6 of the type; painted 12.9 m), beam 3.2; free 1.9 (its deck painted 2.0 m over the water), within the page's boarding reach of the bank. No stern house: the man in the after hood's mouth sits on the open stern gallery (a house would hide him); no bow canopy (its bow is painted hidden). No mooring line or sweep (painted none). Waits on the boat factory: the barrel-vaulted mat hood with three bundles and the open arched hood over the after deck (B1), the lattice rail of the raised gallery.
S2.veh.boat_grain_27285: 万石船, grain boat 1 (types #28, pin 8; catalogue: grain_laden, the factory's model): kind grain, hold laden (the mat mound under its rope net, the hatch boards), lw 12 (0.6 of the type; painted 8.6 m seen from its stern), beam 3.6 (broad); free 0.7 (its gunwale painted 0.69 m over the water: deep-laden). Its bow deckhouse under mat roofs is a mat-roofed house at 0.76-0.92 of the hull. Its cleated gangplank from the north gunwale near the stern up the bank: the foot at the built bank's edge, (262.87, 11.08) at H 0, the bank-top point nearest the painted plank's top (28023, 1050); two mooring lines from its bitts to the rope coil (S2.prop.coiled_rope_27873, at its own place on the bank top) and the stake (S2.prop.mooring_stake_27902). Not moved: its bow lies 2.1 m off the shore, the shore here stays as mapped (the moved bank top narrows the broad wash slope). Waits on the boat factory: the two overlapping mat roofs over the bow deckhouse (B1); the long spar along its deck (a lowered mast or windlass beam) is not built.
S2.veh.boat_grain_28095: 万石船, grain boat 2 (types #29; catalogue: grain_laden): kind grain, hold laden, lw 12 (0.6 of the type; painted 7.9 m, its stern hidden under S1's willow), beam 3.6, free 0.71 (painted 0.71); heavy coils on its after deck. Moved south-west (moves). Its mooring line to S2.prop.mooring_post_rope_28272 is not built: from where it lies at real size the line would run across grain boat 1's stern. Waits on the boat factory: the mat hood with a coiled mat over the bow (B1), the small windlass frame aft (B3), the ladder down to the bottom boat (B8).
S2.veh.boat_bottom_28395: a smaller planked boat at the silk's bottom edge, rafted to grain boat 2 by a ladder (types #30; the lead's note and the catalogue: small_open): the scan (gen/sections/canal/boats/crops/bottom_28395.jpg) shows a small planked hull about 7 m with its rudder, an upswept stern over a transom gallery and round bitts: kind small, open, lw 6.0 (0.75 of the type; painted 5.0 m to the rudder's head), beam 2.0, free 0.9 (painted 125 px of side, high-sided). No cargo or crew. Waits on the boat factory: the upswept stern, the transom gallery and the big rudder (B6), the small upright structure on its deck, the ladder up to grain boat 2 (B8).
